summary: Iteration 2 bug-fix retest. Backend: 48/48 pytest cases pass, the 35 original cases plus 13 new TestIter2 cases. The 7 cases that failed in iteration 1 now pass. A fake, corrupted or encrypted PDF, or a non-image sent to jpg-to-pdf, now returns 400 with a specific detail message. Non-numeric and reversed page specs return 400 for remove-pages, organize and split. A huge range (1-999999999) returns 400 in about 0.12s for all three tools. Compress on a 10.1MB image-heavy PDF: low 2.9MB, medium 530KB, high 107KB. Each output is a valid PDF with the same page count, and none is larger than its input. All 6 tools give correct output. /sitemap.xml, /robots.txt and /ads.txt are served from the preview URL. UI: a fake PDF upload shows 'File is not a valid PDF document.' in tool-error. A simulated 60MB file shows the 50MB limit error. Admin login, dashboard, session after reload, logout and the protected-route redirect all work. The mobile menu lists Remove PDF Pages and Organize PDF.

minor.issue: Both trust the FIRST X-Forwarded-For entry, which the client controls. An attacker can rotate the XFF header to get past the 5-failure lockout (the identifier is ip:email) and the slowapi rate limits. Use the last hop added by the trusted proxy, or key the lockout on email alone.
'Failed Jobs' includes 400 validation rejections (bad page spec, fake file), so user input errors inflate the failure stats. Consider tracking these separately. Low priority.

action_items: Deployment mismatch: firebase.json uses public='dist' and DEPLOYMENT.md says Vite / 'vite build' / dist/. The app is CRA/craco ('craco build' outputs build/). Change firebase.json public to 'build' and fix DEPLOYMENT.md, otherwise the deploy will publish an empty or missing folder.
Harden client IP detection so the lockout and rate limit cannot be bypassed by spoofing X-Forwarded-For (minor).
critical_code_review_comments: seed_admin inserts the admin only when missing and never overwrites the password (correct). bcrypt is used for hashing.
CORS allow_credentials is False when origins='*'. Same-origin cookie auth still works in the preview.
ToolRunner.addFiles: when several files are selected and some are over 50MB, only the last oversize name appears in the error. Acceptable.
seed_data_creation: None. Tool jobs created by the tests show up in the admin stats.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_mycrushpdf_api.py. The tool page run button is data-testid='process-btn' and errors appear in 'tool-error'. Known accepted gaps, not retested: admin SEO tab not wired to pages; client-side-only meta.
